extracted.name: Creamy Chicken Tetrazzini
extracted.description: Chicken, mushrooms, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, and spaghettini come together in this easy, comforting baked casserole.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C).
Break spaghettini into 1 inch pieces. Cook according to package directions; drain.

Meanwhile, cook mushrooms in butter until softened. Cut cooked chicken into large pieces and mix with mushrooms. Stir in sour cream and condensed soup. Fold in spaghettini. Transfer mixture to a buttered casserole dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.
